title: sponsor 1.0
description: sponsors::Sponsor (proposal): a sponsor brand with its decal designs, its My Team secondary sponsor rows in every career data group, its discovery and, optionally, a team badge emblem. Stock sponsors are game/<code> (128 in F1 25), so layers can change their names, logos and tiles. The core writes the sponsors.sponsor, DecalGroup, DecalSet, unlock, reward and secondary_sponsor rows, the menu and car textures with their texture registry entries, and allocates every id. Fields marked (native) need the runtime part described in docs/design/sponsor-registry.md.

template.description: The stock sponsor whose rows a new sponsor copies (values, loyalty track, discovery event). null: game/avolo.

code.description: The database label (_metadata_) and texture prefix. Absent: the record key. Unique in the game.

designs.description: The decal designs. Each is a DecalSet row, a menu texture (340 x 244) and a car texture (1024 x 1024, full mip chain) in both customisation_decals shader archives.

emblem.description: A team badge emblem of the brand (BadgeEmblem row, 512 x 512 texture, unlock rows). Its designs are then free stickers: available from the start, never paid, listed while the team badge uses the emblem (native).

extends.description: Data files only: this record is a variant of that record, and its value is a merge patch on the base.

path.description: A Path: a file or folder in the addon's folder, the game's original file (stock), or resources in an archive. null: empty.

text.description: A Text: a lang key as a string, or a literal.

stat_id.description: A StatId: an explicit id, or "auto" (absent: "auto") for the core to allocate one.

key.description: A design key: p (primary), n (alternate), d3..d12 (more start designs), s1..s9 (loyalty designs). Its DecalSet row is <code>_<key>.

design.description: One decal design. image null: the brand logo. name absent: the brand name (lng_sponsor_<code>_<key>). id: the DecalSet id; saved liveries store it, so once used it never changes.

required_xp.description: Levels with the same required_xp unlock together.

design.description: The design this level unlocks. null: none; its row's decal is written empty, never a missing name.

livery.description: A livery reward label, or null.

career.description: The My Team secondary sponsor, written to every MyTeamSponsorsDataGroup (both car years).

available_from_start.description: Appended to initial_secondary_sponsors (list-append, never set). The game applies that list only when a career is created; the core also discovers the sponsor in existing My Team careers at load (native).

discovery.description: Its own discovery department event, cloned from the template's. null: none (only with available_from_start or an emblem).

default_designs.description: default_decals: owned once discovered. Absent: every start design (p, n, d3..).

loyalty.description: Loyalty levels over the template's track. Absent: level n unlocks design s<n>, or none.

emblem.description: image null: the brand logo. id: the BadgeEmblem id, which the team badge stores (not a statId).

placement.description: Where the decal sits on one car year's model, in the decal editor's own values.

fixed.description: A sponsor the My Team livery always carries in one projection area (native). locked true: kept like the title sponsor's decal (no swap, delete, duplicate or mirror; not paid per decal). locked false: placed once; the player may remove it.

area.description: The ProjectionArea label without fom_car_<year>_ (left_nose, top_nose, rear_wing_top...).

placement.description: Per car year; absent: the area's default origin and size.

my_team.description: My Team behaviour beyond the stock data (native).

engines.description: entrants.engines labels: an engine supplier's sponsor, listed only while the team's engine is one of these, taken off the livery when the supplier changes, never paid per decal.

paid.description: false: its decals earn no weekly per-decal income.
